payload.core_mechanism_summary: For each station i, clear time = (count-1)*n + min distance to a destination. Answer for start s is max over i of (circular distance s->i + clear time of i).
payload.rationale: Solution directly computes the known greedy formula for the Toy Train problem, using min distance as optimal final leg, without any exchange argument, sorting, or priority queue. Best matching available subtype is greedy_exchange_argument due to top score.
